requirements.requirement: Provide tidy, compartmented storage for sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: Built 4 cells with bins: bin:-1,1,0~hex-bin-full (open storage), bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments for notions/buttons), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments for small items), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, plus notch:0#0,-1#notch5 with 3 compartments between cells. Cover:1,0,0;full;top provides a flat work surface. Build verified: check_build ok, meshClash clear, joints locked and open faces capped.

Installed 3x hex-acc-rod sockets (accessory:0#1,0#0, accessory:0#1,0#1 at 1,0,0 and accessory:0#1,-1#2 at 1,-1,0) intended for spool axles/thread stands. No axle offer was available in current layout (find_sockets axle = 0), so no filament-spool axle could be placed. Bins themselves can hold spools/tape as loose storage - no dedicated sewing-thread props exist in catalog.

finish.summary: Built compact 5-cell sewing caddy (4 hex cells + 1 notch tray) with mixed bins: 2-compartment and 3-compartment trays for buttons/pins/notions, 2 full bins for fabric/scissors, plus a covered cell for flat workspace. Added 3 rod sockets for future spool axles, capped open faces and locked joints. No sewing-specific props exist to stage, but storage geometry meets tidy-organization brief; thread-spool axle not completable with current offers.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
